challenge.method: Compare the exact proto2 section with the publisher's Editions guide and the pinned specimen. Check the label versus field-presence distinction and whether map or oneof behavior follows from the quoted enumeration.
challenge.results: The guide's proto2 cardinality distinctions and recommendation are explicit. The Editions guide documents LEGACY_REQUIRED field presence rather than the proto2 required declaration label, which confines any interpretation of removal to the label in the scoped guide. Map and oneof follow separate sections.

limitations: Repeated-value order refers to the documented field behavior. It does not establish field ordering between different fields or deterministic wire bytes.
No runtime or compiler implementation test was required for the documentary wording.
